title: Implementation measure
description: Something an instrument depends on to work in practice: a delegated or implementing act, Commission guidelines, a code of practice, a template, an AI Board output, a standardisation request, a harmonised standard, or an international standard work item. Standards are recorded as metadata only (reference, body, stage, dates and a link); never standard text. Every factual field is optional and null until read from the official source. The status is what the record declares; "overdue" is never written here, it is derived from due_on and today's date.

instrument.description: Slug of the policy record the measure implements (e.g. eu-ai-act). Null for a standard that implements no recorded instrument.

related_policy.description: Slug of a policy record that describes the same document (e.g. the ISO/IEC 42001 record).

status.description: Declared status. "unverified" marks a draft record whose status has not been read from a source. "overdue" is derived, not declared.

legal_basis.description: The provision(s) of the instrument that call for or concern the measure, as the source states them.

published_on_precision.description: How much of published_on the source states. With "year" the date must be 1 January of that year and is shown as the year only.

body.description: Who produces the measure. For standards: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 or ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42.

reference.description: Document reference, e.g. "ISO/IEC 42001:2023" or a CELEX number.

stage.description: Standards work-item stage as the standards body publishes it.

oj_citation_expected_on.description: Harmonised standards only: when citation in the Official Journal is expected, from an official source.

oj_citation_on.description: Harmonised standards only: when the reference was cited in the Official Journal.
